skill.name: youtube-automation
skill.description: Automate YouTube publishing, search, playlist management, channel metrics, subscriptions, and comment retrieval through the Rube MCP YouTube toolkit.
skill.summary: Guide reliable YouTube workflows through Rube MCP with current tool schemas, pagination, batching, and quota awareness.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All 55 external-command detections are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, and both reconnaissance detections describe ordinary YouTube data handling. The external Rube MCP endpoint is a real low-severity trust boundary. A medium-severity concern remains because account-changing workflows do not require confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: Account-changing YouTube actions can run without an explicit final approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation after showing the target account and exact changes before uploads, metadata updates, playlist changes, subscriptions, or unsubscriptions.

remediation.issue: The workflow depends on an external MCP endpoint with access to YouTube authorization.
remediation.suggestion: Document the service trust boundary, verify the endpoint, request minimal OAuth scopes, and explain how users can revoke access.

static_findings.snippet: - Active YouTube connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `youtube`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `categoryId`: YouTube category ID (e.g., '22' for People & Blogs)
- `videoFilePath`: Object with `{name, mimetype, s3key}` for the video file
- Angle brackets `< >` in tags are automatically stripped
2. `YOUTUBE_VIDEO_DETAILS` - Get full details for a specific video [Optional]
- `q`: Search query (supports exact phrases, exclusions, channel handles)
3. `YOUTUBE_ADD_VIDEO_TO_PLAYLIST` - Add a video to a playlist [Optional]
- `playlistId`: Playlist ID ('PL...' for user-created, 'UU...' for uploads)
1. `YOUTUBE_GET_CHANNEL_ID_BY_HANDLE` - Resolve a handle to channel ID [Prerequisite]
3. `YOUTUBE_LIST_CHANNEL_VIDEOS` - List all videos from a channel [Optional]
- `id`: Comma-separated video IDs for batch details
- Response data may be nested under `data` or `data_preview`; parse defensively
- Pass token as `pageToken` in next request
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- items[].id is not the videoId; use items[].snippet.resourceId.videoId
- Monitor quota usage to avoid hitting daily limits

content.user_title: Automate YouTube Workflows with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Managing YouTube through changing APIs requires repetitive tool selection, pagination, and quota decisions. This skill guides Rube MCP workflows for publishing, discovery, playlists, metrics, subscriptions, and comments.
actual_capabilities: Checks current Rube MCP tool schemas before starting a YouTube workflow.
Guides video uploads, metadata updates, privacy settings, tags, and thumbnail changes.
Searches videos, channels, and playlists, then retrieves detailed video data.
Creates playlists, adds videos, and lists playlist contents with pagination.
Retrieves channel statistics, video metrics, activities, subscriptions, and comment threads.
Handles pagination, batch limits, identifier formats, and YouTube quota considerations.
limitations: Requires access to Rube MCP and a connected YouTube account authorized through Google OAuth.
Depends on current Rube tool schemas because several exact request fields are not documented.
Channel statistics are lifetime totals, not period-specific YouTube Analytics reports.
YouTube quotas, permissions, disabled comments, and private content can limit results.

use_cases.title: Publish channel videos
use_cases.description: Prepare and publish videos with validated metadata, privacy settings, tags, and optional thumbnails.

use_cases.title: Research competing content
use_cases.description: Search a topic, collect video details in batches, and compare public channel or video metrics.

use_cases.title: Maintain curated playlists
use_cases.description: Create playlists, add selected videos, and enumerate large collections across every results page.

prompt_templates.title: Search for videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Search YouTube for [topic]. Return up to [count] videos with titles, channels, publication dates, and links. Fetch details when statistics are requested.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a video upload
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an upload for [video asset] using title [title], privacy [status], and category [category]. Show the final metadata and quota impact before requesting approval.

prompt_templates.title: Build a playlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Find videos matching [criteria] and propose a playlist named [name]. Check existing playlists and duplicates, then request approval before creating or adding items.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a channel catalog
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve channel [handle], enumerate all videos, and retrieve details in batches. Compare views, likes, comments, and durations while reporting missing items and quota use.

output_examples.input: Find five recent accessibility tutorials and compare their public engagement.
output: Search summary: five recent tutorials matched the topic and date criteria.
Comparison: each result includes title, channel, publication date, views, likes, comments, and link.
Notes: unavailable statistics and additional result pages are identified clearly.

output_examples.input: Prepare my product demonstration for an unlisted upload with a custom thumbnail.
output: Upload plan: video asset, title, description, tags, category, and unlisted privacy setting are validated.
Thumbnail check: image type, size, dimensions, and channel verification requirements are reviewed.
Approval request: the final metadata, target account, and estimated quota cost are shown before upload.

output_examples.input: Summarize the performance of every public video from a channel.
output: Channel summary: public lifetime totals and catalog size are reported.
Video table: views, likes, comments, duration, and publication date are compared.
Coverage note: pagination, batch count, private or deleted omissions, and quota use are disclosed.

best_practices: Search for current tool schemas before every workflow that uses Rube MCP.
Show the target account and exact changes before requesting approval for account mutations.
Use list endpoints, pagination, and batches of about 50 video identifiers to conserve quota.
anti_patterns: Do not upload a video when only metadata needs updating.
Do not pass channel identifiers as playlist identifiers or playlist item identifiers as video identifiers.
Do not ignore pagination tokens, quota costs, missing results, or changed tool schemas.

faq.question: What connection does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires Rube MCP and an active YouTube connection completed through Google OAuth.

faq.question: Does the skill store a Google API key?
faq.answer: No API key is described. Authentication is delegated to the external Rube MCP service through OAuth.

faq.question: Can it upload and edit videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers uploads, metadata changes, privacy settings, tags, and custom thumbnails when permissions allow.

faq.question: Can it provide historical analytics?
faq.answer: No. The documented channel statistics are lifetime totals, while video details provide current public metrics.

faq.question: How does it handle large result sets?
faq.answer: It follows pagination tokens and retrieves video details in batches of about 50 identifiers.

faq.question: What should users review before an account change?
faq.answer: Review the connected account, target resource, exact metadata, privacy setting, quota cost, and requested OAuth permissions.
